texts.orig: ABSTRACT . Let H be Hurwitz space that parametrises   holomorphic maps to Abramovich;_Corti and Vistoli, building on work of Harris and Mumford, describe a pactification H with a natural boundary stratification. We show that the irreducible strata of H are in bijection with combinatorial objects called decorated trees (up to a suitable equivalence) , and that containment of irreducible strata is given by edge contraction of decorated trees. This combinatorial description allows us to define a tropical Hurwitz space; refining definition given by Cavalieri; Markwig and Ranganathan.  We also discuss applications to complex dynamics.
